principle: dimension annotation > raster pixel position; nothing guessed silently

assumptions.assumption: single uniform affine transform for the whole raster: X_mm=(px-86.5)*37.045, Y_mm=(684.5-py)*36.49
assumptions.basis: least-squares fit over 16 bottom-chain + 12 top-chain + 10 right-chain tick anchors

assumptions.assumption: bottom outer chain reads 1400+1400+3000+2100+3600+3900+900 = 16300mm, ending at px526.5
assumptions.basis: top chain independently gives 2800+13500=16300 with matching tick spacing; the apparent trailing digits on the bottom chain are chain-tail notation, not 16900
assumptions.impact: east exterior datum X16300; drawn outer face px528.5 (X16470) treated as wall thickness overshoot

assumptions.assumption: interior walls modelled with raster-measured thickness (~100-280mm); exterior walls ~200mm where measurable
assumptions.basis: source is a marketing/developer plan — wall thicknesses are symbolic, not engineering-accurate

assumptions.assumption: where a wall face line is drawn but the door swing arc crosses it, the opening is real and the face line is drafting convention
assumptions.impact: openings modelled as recorded even when one wall face reads continuous in raster

assumptions.assumption: no wall is marked load-bearing; all structural_role = UNKNOWN
assumptions.basis: source provides no structural information; black fill ≠ bearing wall
assumptions.impact: none — explicitly required by task rules

assumptions.assumption: no storey height is in the source; IFC uses visualization_only_height_mm=2800 marked NOT SOURCE DATA
assumptions.impact: FCStd/IFC volumes are placeholders for spatial review only

assumptions.assumption: origin X0 at bottom-chain datum px86.5 even though no wall face exists there (ISSUE-001); Y0 at main south face px684.5
assumptions.basis: keeps every bottom-chain tick at its printed cumulative dimension
assumptions.impact: west balcony railing sits at X1400, west exterior wall at X2800
